definition: A familiar biblical image for a ruler or leader who protects, guides, and provides for a people. The image also emphasizes the dependence of the flock on its keeper.
The Scriptures use love for affection, friendship, and especially the deliberate self-giving care that fulfills God's command. Its fullest pattern is seen in God's action toward the world.
The created order is presented as the work of the one living God. Creation language grounds the Bible's account of God's authority and the world's dependence on him.
